name: pnpm (via npm)
description: Installs pnpm via npm. Based on devcontainers-extra/features/pnpm. This feature does not install nodejs or npm.

version.description: Select the version/range of pnpm to install (for example, '10' to stay on the latest pnpm v10).

configureMinimumReleaseAge.description: Run 'pnpm config set minimumReleaseAge --global'. No-op on v11+ which already defaults to 1440, but useful for v10.
